teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering loops, variables, and conditionals, and answered student questions during office hours.
Graded programming exercises using an instructor-provided rubric as part of assigned teaching assistant responsibilities.

teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Supported beginner programming practice sessions focused on lists and dictionaries, as well as loops.
Explained worked examples involving lists, dictionaries, and loops under a course instructor's supervision.

projects.title: Command-Line Expense Tracker
bullets: Implemented a small command-line expense tracker in Python using functions and collections for an individual undergraduate course project.
Tested example inputs and documented the program's behaviour, using Git as a project tool.
